title: Women's Golden Retriever – I Brought You a Sock Embroidered Zip Hoodie
who: the woman whose retriever greets her at the door with a sock and a wagging tail, zipped on for the dog park and the walk home.
art: A golden retriever bounds forward with a striped sock in its mouth through a wreath of poppies, daisies, ferns and wildflowers, in orange, red, sage, mustard and cream with a worn print texture.
headline: I BROUGHT YOU A SOCK.
inks: orange and cream on Black and Navy, rust and navy on Ash
layout_story: I BROUGHT YOU A SOCK. runs above it and YOU'RE WELCOME. below in heavy slab capitals, the second block a touch wider than the first
layout_faq: I BROUGHT YOU A SOCK. above the dog and YOU'RE WELCOME. below
chest: a small golden retriever head holding a striped sock
warm2: chilly dog walks, damp dog parks and the drive home with a wet dog
gift_line: for the friend whose retriever has never once come home empty-mouthed.
seo_desc: A golden retriever zip up hoodie: I BROUGHT YOU A SOCK. YOU'RE WELCOME. on the back over a retriever and flowers, plus an embroidered retriever on the chest.
